app.name: TVBalance
app.tagline: Healthy screen-time rules for your family's smart TV

welcome.title: Welcome to TVBalance
welcome.intro: Let's set things up in three quick steps.
welcome.passwordHelp: This password protects the rules. Keep it to yourself.
welcome.passwordShort: The password needs at least {{min}} characters.
welcome.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
welcome.rulesHelp: Start from a ready-made rule and fine-tune it later.

login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Enter your password, or the PIN for quick access.
login.wrong: That is not right. Try again.
login.pinLocked: Too many wrong PINs. Sign in with the password.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.empty: No TV yet. Add the first one to start.

region.timezoneHint: Schedules and daily limits follow this time zone.

presets.schoolSummary: Weekdays 16:00–20:00, weekends 09:00–21:00, up to 2 hours a day, warnings at 10 and 5 minutes.

errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in {{seconds}} s.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do that.
errors.conflict: That conflicts with the current state.
errors.tv_offline: The TV is not reachable right now.
errors.unavailable: The Engine is starting. Try again in a moment.
errors.adapter_mismatch: This TV was added with another brand.
errors.invalid_license: This license key is not valid.

limit.budget: the daily time is used up
limit.app_budget: the app group's time is used up

actions.allowHelp: The TV is allowed even outside the rules, for the time you choose.
actions.blockHelp: The TV is blocked, whatever the rules say, for the time you choose.

rules.title: Rules
rules.intro: A rule set says when and how long a TV may be used. Each TV follows one set; several TVs can share it.
rules.newHelp: Give it a name and pick a starting point. You can change everything afterwards.
rules.name: Name
rules.unused: Not used by any TV yet
rules.cannotSave: These rules can't be saved yet:

issue.fallback_not_always_allowed: The fallback must be always allowed.
issue.conflicting_lists: An item is both blocked and always allowed.
issue.invalid_warn_threshold: A warning is longer than the daily budget.
issue.negative_budget: The daily budget can't be negative.
issue.invalid_weekday: A weekday must be between 0 (Monday) and 6 (Sunday).
issue.duplicate_app_budget: Two app groups have the same name.
issue.empty_app_budget: An app group has no apps.

rules.noWindows: No time window: the TV is off limits all day.
rules.scheduleHelp: When the TV may be used, day by day.
rules.specialDaysHelp: Different hours for one date, such as a holiday.
rules.warningsHelp: Show a message when this many minutes are left.
rules.inventoryOffline: The TV can't be reached: type ids by hand instead.
rules.inventoryNoTv: No TV yet: type ids by hand.
rules.allowListHelp: When on, every app not listed is blocked.
rules.alwaysAllowedHelp: Never blocked, even outside the schedule or over budget.
rules.fallbackHelp: Where the TV goes when the current content is blocked.
rules.advancedHelp: How firmly blocks are enforced. The defaults suit nearly everyone.

escalation.debounceHelp: Ignores very short visits to blocked content.
escalation.graceHelp: Time to finish after the warning message.
escalation.power_off_capHelp: After this many forced power-offs the Engine stops retrying.
escalation.cap_windowHelp: Period over which power-offs are counted.
escalation.cap_pauseHelp: How long the Engine waits once the cap is hit.
escalation.message_repeatHelp: How often the on-screen message is shown again.

rules.advancedBudgetsHelp: A budget for each weekday, a shared allowance for groups of apps, and unused time carried over to the next day.
rules.advancedBudgetsPro: Advanced budgets need the Pro plan; until then they are saved but only the daily budget applies.
rules.weekdayBudgetsHelp: Leave a day empty to use the daily budget above.
rules.appGroupsHelp: Apps in a group share one daily allowance, such as 45 minutes for games.
rules.rolloverHelp: Minutes not used today are added to tomorrow, up to a limit. They don't pile up from day to day.

event.redirected: The TV was sent to a safe place
event.pairing_lost: The TV needs to be paired again

tvDetail.name: Name
tvDetail.enabledHelp: When off, the Engine leaves the TV alone.
tvDetail.removeHelp: The TV is no longer monitored.
tvDetail.needsPairing: This TV needs to be paired again before it can be monitored.
tvDetail.planLimited: This TV is set up but not supervised: the Free plan covers one TV. Add a Pro license in Settings, or turn off the other TVs.

settings.title: Settings
settings.pinHelp: A short code that lets you open the controls on a shared device without the password. It can pause, add time and allow or block, nothing more.
settings.sessionsHelp: Every browser that is currently signed in.
settings.signOutSession: Sign out the device last seen {{when}}
settings.tokensHelp: For other programs, such as Home Assistant. For Home Assistant choose read and control.
settings.tokenShownOnce: Copy this token now. It won't be shown again.
settings.tokenCopyFailed: Couldn't copy: select the token and copy it by hand.

pairing.title: Add a TV
pairing.noneFound: No TV found. Enter its address below.
pairing.manualHelp: If your TV is not listed, pick its brand and type its IP address or host name. You can find it in the TV's network settings.
pairing.waiting: Waiting for you to accept on the TV…
pairing.failed: Pairing did not work. Check that the TV is on and try again.
pairing.expired: Time ran out before the TV was accepted. Try again.
pairing.finishHelp: Give the TV a name and choose the rules it follows. You can change both later.
pairing.capabilities: What TVBalance can do with this TV

instructions.generic: Turn the TV on and keep the remote at hand. When you start, the TV asks you to accept the connection.
instructions.lg_webos: Turn the LG TV on and keep the remote at hand. When you start, a message appears on the TV: choose Yes with the remote.

pairing.freeNotice: The Free plan supervises one TV. You can add this one, but it stays inactive until you add a Pro license in Settings.

push.title: Notifications
push.help: Get a notification on this device when something needs your attention.
push.insecure: Notifications need a secure (HTTPS) connection. Open TVBalance through Home Assistant's Ingress over HTTPS, or from localhost.
push.unsupported: This browser can't show push notifications. On iPhone and iPad, add TVBalance to the Home Screen first.
push.denied: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in your browser's site settings, then reload.
push.enabled: Notifications are on for this device.
push.testGone: This device is no longer registered. Turn notifications on again.
push.testFailed: The push service could not be reached. Try again later.

event.pairing_lost: The TV needs to be paired again

push.secureAddress: Open the secure address to turn notifications on.

https.banner: This page is not encrypted. Use the secure address to keep your password private.

secure.title: Secure connection
secure.help: TVBalance can answer over HTTPS on your home network with a certificate it creates and renews by itself.
secure.offNote: HTTPS is turned off. Turn it on in the add-on or engine settings.
secure.skipped: Not included in the certificate (outside the allowed local names): {{names}}
secure.caHelp: Install the certificate on each device that opens TVBalance, then compare the fingerprint above with the one the device shows.

ios.name: iPhone and iPad
ios.steps: Open the profile, allow it in Settings, install it, then turn it on in Settings > General > About > Certificate Trust Settings.

android.name: Android
android.steps: Open Settings, search for "CA certificate", choose Install anyway and pick the downloaded file.

windows.name: Windows
windows.steps: Open the file, choose Install Certificate, Local Machine, and place it in Trusted Root Certification Authorities.

mac.name: macOS
mac.steps: Open the file in Keychain Access, then set Trust to Always Trust for this certificate.

secure.rotateHelp: Devices that trusted the old certificate must install the new one, and the Home Assistant integration will ask you to confirm it again.
secure.customNote: TVBalance is using your own certificate. Devices must already trust it.

license.title: TVBalance Pro
license.help: Free supervises one TV. A Pro license, bought once for the whole household, removes the limit. It is checked on this device and needs no internet.

status.expired: The license has expired, so the Free plan applies.
status.invalid: The stored license key is no longer valid, so the Free plan applies.

license.removeHelp: The household goes back to the Free plan. Your settings are kept, but only the oldest enabled TV is supervised.

profiles.activateHelp: The rule set applies to every TV in the household, except the ones you leave out.
profiles.excluded: TVs that keep their own rules
profiles.requiresPro: Profiles and the calendar need the Pro plan; until then they are saved but not applied.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.intro: Switch rule sets on automatically, on certain weekdays or during a period such as the holidays.
calendar.formHelp: A dated entry wins over a weekly one.
calendar.overnight: An end before the start runs past midnight.
